thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 3333 — az1a inference 5xx spike. Alert: inference-service-5xx-rate > 10% (5m). Affected: model-serving-prod in us-east-1a (az1a). Pager: @sara. Runbook: single-az-network-impaired.

sara: ack, I'm oncall. gathering details. @michael can you pull kube events, svc/endpoint counts, and ipam status?

michael: on it. quick snapshot: several model-serving pods returning 502/503 at grpc-proxy layer. Found ipam-controller OOMKilled ~5m ago and service IP allocation failures in kube-proxy logs: 
```
May 03 02:38:12 kube-proxy ERROR failed to assign service IP: no addresses left in range
May 03 02:39:01 ipam-controller OOMKilled
```
Collecting `kubectl get pods -n infra` and `kubectl describe pod ipam-controller`.

tess: metrics — 5xx at 12% cluster-wide for model-serving-prod, 95p latency from 1.2s -> 2.6s. KV cache miss rate up 3x. Customer visible: timeouts and retries on heavy inference endpoints.

infra-bot: Autoscaler attempted to request extra ENIs but hit soft ENI quota in az1a; cross-az capacity available.

jordan: proposal — immediate traffic steering for affected workloads to eu-west-1 standby capacity + restart ipam-controller and free service CIDR on cluster. That should reduce 5xx while we repair.

sara: agree. @jordan kick off the traffic-steer playbook and tag affected tenants. I'll cordon nodes in az1a that show depleted svc IP ranges. Marking incident as paging. :rotating_light:

michael: executing runbook steps now:
```bash
kubectl cordon node/az1a-worker-07
kubectl drain node/az1a-worker-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
kubectl rollout restart deploy/ipam-controller -n infra
```
I'll also increase service IP pool if possible: patch cluster serviceCIDR + allocate secondary range where supported.

tess: routing change started — updated smart-routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 for tenant groups alpha/beta. Early signals: 5xx for rerouted traffic down to ~4-5%. Latency for rerouted requests ~1.4s stable.

customer-success: prepping notif for top 5 impacted customers: short note + mitigation steps + ETA ~60m. Draft: "We saw a regional IP allocation issue in us-east-1a causing intermittent 5xx for inference. We've routed traffic to EU standby capacity and are fixing the control plane; we'll follow up with timeline."

sara: good. handoff plan — I'll own until ipam-controller shows stable allocs for 30m, then hand to @michael at 03:15 UTC for recovery verification. Postmortem owner: @jordan.

michael: ipam-controller restart completed, pods stable, service IP pool usage dropping from 98% -> 70% after drains and routing. Still seeing some client retries; KV cache warming in eu-west.

incident-bot: UPDATE — severity lowered to sev-2. 5xx now ~6% cluster-wide and falling on rerouted paths. Next update in 30m or on stabilization. :white_check_mark:
